fields.description: Weekly issue of the Miami Life newspaper dated January 21, 1928 (Vol. 11, No. 1). Includes local commentary such as delays in bridge construction near Little River and discussion of choosing a University of Miami football coach. Features columns and satire (e.g., "Round the Town," "Thing I'd Like to Know," "The Meanest Man in the World"), coverage and promotion of Nassau travel and hospitality (Princess Montagu; Fort Montague Hotel; Lucerne Hotel), and discussion of Prohibition-era enforcement and a federal court case involving liquor-running. Contains Miami Beach and Coral Gables cultural notes (Garden Theatre production of "Rain"; Venetian Pool promotion), letters to the editor, and numerous local advertisements for businesses and services.
